title: Nightscout data different to Xdrip
body:
Hi Guys
My son's Nightscout Reports data is different to Xdrip. For example at midday today, 6th October, Xdrip shows up to midday. Nightscout shows a full day! Live data on both shows the same (up to midday),
Any ideas how that can happen & how to fix it?
Thanks
Ali

comments.body: @alexmoir1 This probably is a glitch in Nightscout - did you set your timezone properly? UTC (the default) seems to cause offsets by up to a full day
Yes that was it. There seems to be several settings for GMT/UTC. Changing it sorted the issue.
